Find figure and table files used by a TeX report

Source: R/tex-paths.R
getAssetPathsFromTex.Rd

Compile the main report with LaTeX and return its figure and table paths in one call. LaTeX resolves macros, conditions, nested includes, imports, image search paths, and extensions. The report must build with an installed LaTeX engine and its required packages and assets.

getAssetPathsFromTex(.file)

Arguments

.file

Path to the main TeX report.

Value

A list with figures and tables character vectors. Paths are unique and normalized, relative to the most specific containing directory among the working directory and here::here(), or absolute when neither contains them. Empty categories are returned as character().

Details

The report directory is the working directory for compilation. Build outputs go to a temporary directory and shell escape is disabled. A % !TeX program directive selects the engine; otherwise installed pdfLaTeX, LuaLaTeX, and XeLaTeX engines are tried in that order. Auxiliary files must stabilize within four passes. Failed builds raise an error rather than return a partial list. External asset generators and bibliography tools are not run.

Figures are files used by LaTeX graphics commands. Tables are files read inside table/tabular environments, or included files that execute a tabular environment. Tables written directly in the main report have no separate asset path and are omitted. Custom table mechanisms using neither table nor tabular environments cannot be classified as tables. Low-level engine image primitives that bypass LaTeX graphics commands are not traced.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  assets <- getAssetPathsFromTex("deliv/report/report.tex")
  assets$figures
  assets$tables
} # }
